# Place learn/agentos/DockZoneModel.md on a reference shelf in learn/tree.json and link from dock guides

## Context

Sub-issue of `#20498` implementing **Row 13 (`dock-zone-contract-shelf`)** of the three-reader `learn/` map ([`#20498#issuecomment-6697670393`](https://github.com/neomjs/neo/issues/20498#issuecomment-6697670393)).

- **Ownership disposition:** `unowned-rationale: claimable leaf under #20498 per map #issuecomment-6697670393 (delegated filing by @neo-fable-mnemosyne)`

## The Problem

`learn/agentos/DockZoneModel.md` (`40 KB`) is an exhaustive technical contract and specification sitting directly among the top-level storytelling guides in `"Brain Interface, Fleet & Agent Tooling"` (`learn/tree.json`), violating `.agents/skills/guide-authoring/references/guide-authoring-bar.md` §4 (*"Reference ≠ guide: link it, don't inline it. When a guide needs a reference table or contract spec, link the reference file; don't let a 40 KB contract sit unmarked in a storytelling sequence"*).

Design authority: `#20498` + `#20498#issuecomment-6697670393` (Row 13 `dock-zone-contract-shelf`) + `.agents/skills/guide-authoring/references/guide-authoring-bar.md` §4.

## The Architectural Reality

- The 10-part dock-layout guide series under `learn/guides/uibuildingblocks/DockLayouts*.md` (`236 KB`) and `learn/agentos/decisions/0029-multi-window-docking-design.md` are the primary storytelling and decision surfaces for multi-window docking.
- Grouping `learn/agentos/DockZoneModel.md` onto a dedicated Reference / Contracts shelf in `learn/tree.json` (and cross-linking it from the dock-layout guides and ADR `0029`) keeps the top-level `"Brain Interface, Fleet & Agent Tooling"` sequence focused on narrative guides while preserving `DockZoneModel.md`'s exact file path and URL route.

## The Fix

1. In `learn/tree.json`, place `agentos/DockZoneModel` under a dedicated reference sub-group (e.g., `"Reference & Contracts"` under `agentos`, which can also house the reference specs from Row 12 if desired) while keeping its file path (`learn/agentos/DockZoneModel.md`) unchanged.
2. Add explicit cross-links to `../../agentos/DockZoneModel.md` from `learn/guides/uibuildingblocks/DockLayoutsArchitecture.md` (and/or `DockLayoutsFirstLayout.md`) and `learn/agentos/decisions/0029-multi-window-docking-design.md`.

## Contract Ledger

| Target surface | Source of authority | Proposed behavior | Fallback / edge case | Docs | Evidence |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| `learn/tree.json` + `learn/guides/uibuildingblocks/DockLayouts*.md` | `#20498#issuecomment-6697670393` Row 13 + `guide-authoring-bar.md` §4 | Move `agentos/DockZoneModel` onto a reference shelf in `learn/tree.json` and link it from the dock-layout guides | Preserve `learn/agentos/DockZoneModel.md` file path so existing links resolve | `learn/tree.json`, `learn/guides/uibuildingblocks/DockLayouts*.md` | `node ./buildScripts/util/check-relative-links.mjs` |

Decision Record impact: `aligned-with` ADR `0029`.

## Acceptance Criteria

- [ ] **AC-1:** `agentos/DockZoneModel` is organized under a reference shelf in `learn/tree.json` rather than sitting unmarked in the top-level storytelling guide sequence.
- [ ] **AC-2:** The dock-layout guide series (`learn/guides/uibuildingblocks/DockLayouts*.md`) links `learn/agentos/DockZoneModel.md`.
- [ ] **AC-3:** `node ./buildScripts/util/check-relative-links.mjs` and `node ./buildScripts/util/check-whitespace.mjs` pass with `0` errors.

## Out of Scope

Moving `learn/agentos/DockZoneModel.md` on disk (keep its path stable); hand-editing `apps/portal/sitemap.xml` or `apps/portal/llms.txt`.

## Avoided Traps

- Breaking inbound relative links to `learn/agentos/DockZoneModel.md`.
